meta.name: cal-com-automation
meta.description: Automate Cal.com tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): manage bookings, check availability, configure webhooks, and handle teams. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Cal.com 日程、预订与团队协作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Cal.com 管理会议和团队日程
copy.tagline_en: Automate Cal.com bookings, availability, and team management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage meetings and team schedules with Cal.com

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 Cal.com 的预约、检查空闲时段、配置网络钩子以及管理团队。它会先搜索当前可用的工具，然后按步骤执行操作。
howto.when: 当你提到预约、空闲时间、网络钩子或团队相关任务时触发。例如，说“帮我查一下明天的空闲时段”或“创建一个新预约”。

say.text: 帮我查一下明天下午的空闲时段。
say.note: Claude 会调用可用性检查工具。

say.text: 创建一个新预约，明天上午10点到11点。
say.note: Claude 会先查空闲时段再创建预约。

say.text: 列出所有即将到来的预约。
say.note: Claude 会调用预约列表工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Cal.com bookings, check availability, configure webhooks, and handle teams. It will first search for current tools, then execute steps accordingly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention bookings, availability, webhooks, or team-related tasks. For example, saying 'Check my free slots for tomorrow' or 'Create a new booking'.

say_en.text: Check my free slots for tomorrow afternoon.
say_en.note: Claude will call the availability check tool.

say_en.text: Create a new booking from 10 AM to 11 AM tomorrow.
say_en.note: Claude will check availability first, then create.
Claude will call the booking list tool.
